title: Enforce engine efficiency regression budgets and optimization handoff
goal: Enforce bounded engineering-engine efficiency regressions, record verified optimization outcomes, and produce the exact handoff into the end-to-end implementation pilot.
outputs: versioned E8-C standard and strict efficiency baselines
invariants: optimization cannot remove mandatory or prerequisite-closed safety gates
absence or corruption of metrics cannot weaken validation
raw source code and secrets are never stored as optimization evidence
security_properties: recommendations are advisory until separately verified
security and correctness floors outrank throughput optimization
acceptance_tests: unit tests prove safety floors block even without a comparable baseline
unit tests prove same-profile validation cost/selection regressions block
unit tests prove context growth remains advisory
unit tests prove a higher mandatory floor requires a new comparable baseline instead of blocking a security increase
real adaptive validation reports current baseline match or explicit no-baseline status

performance_budget.rationale: this layer exists to reduce engine overhead without trading away safety
metrics: ordinary PR validation overhead from metrics collection remains negligible compared with selected checks

rollback.strategy: revert E8 changes while retaining verified E0-E7 behavior

definition_of_done: efficiency regressions are visible and fail according to explicit budgets
security/correctness regressions cannot be traded for speed
handoff identifies remaining engine limitations before E9 pilot
